## Where it comes from

The lists connect the frame-like shape with a **window** —
graded unclear, as so many of the oldest identifications are.
Akkadian reads it *ab* and *ap*, the final consonant softening
to match its word, exactly as its neighbors
<a href="{{ '/cuneiform/addenda-akk/signs/ad/' | relative_url }}">AD</a>
and <a href="{{ '/cuneiform/addenda-akk/signs/ug/' | relative_url }}">UG</a>
do.

## How to remember it

A **window** looks out of a house the way a vowel looks out of
this sign: open on one side. In law 196 it is the ap inside the
court's sentence — a small window in a dark verb.
